description: Create a manual (admin-entered) order. Each item references a product recordId or is an ad-hoc line with name+price (minor units of the order's currency). currency picks the order's currency (default currency when omitted); payments and refunds on the order are in that currency. shippingAddress is optional; for a customer of a company with a verified VAT id its country decides whether the order is reverse charge, and the order freezes that tax treatment (get_order taxTreatment).

currency.description: The order's currency: omit for the default currency, or one of the workspace's additional currencies. Product lines are priced in it - a product with no price in it is refused (NO_PRICE_IN_CURRENCY) - and ad-hoc line prices are minor units of it

price.description: Custom unit price in minor units of the order's currency (ad-hoc item)

recordId.description: Product record id the line refers to

shippingAddress.description: Delivery address. Its country decides reverse charge for a buyer whose company has a verified VAT id
